recipe_type: independently trained all-supplied-data seed-9 strong-parent approximation
scientific_claim_boundary: This is a source-grounded method-compatible experiment, not an exact reproduction of the reported endpoint. All supplied train and valid groups, including previously exposed validation/evaluation groups, are fit data; no local held-out result or public-score claim is available.

reference_basis.reported_endpoint: Wave-18 final teacher package predicts fbc1k_s5 at fixed zero-based epoch 3 with coefficient 0.30; the snapshot does not include its full training ancestry or checkpoint hash.

closest_inspected_predecessor.supported_stage: A four-epoch h256x2 WMSE parent, B16/C1000, Muon multiplier 3, distillation alpha 0.5 with boot horizon 8, EMA and auxiliary targets; it is predecessor evidence, not proof of the endpoint command.

explicit_gaps: No exact fbc1k_s5 parent/teacher checkpoint, initializer, terminal receipt or complete training command is present in the inspected endpoint.

The reference predecessor uses two seed-specific warm-parent predictions as distillation teachers. This first independent run uses the existing own H230 full-row source cache, whose teachers are clean-fold-trained and whose source mixture is not that exact pair.
This first recipe trains one seed-9 parent from fresh initialization; it does not yet provide a paired seed-99 parent or a final equal-weight seed-9/99 student endpoint.
reference_basis.independence: Project-owned V4 trainer and optimizer; fresh own seed-9 initialization; no teammate source code or weights copied or loaded.

data.fresh_launch_rule: Recheck current dataset file/stat identities at preflight; do not rehash full Parquet as part of this recipe freeze.

distillation_target_dependency.prediction_coverage: complete all-supplied train and valid row-group order; this does not make the teacher weights all-data-trained
distillation_target_dependency.main_variant: source, unnormalized weighted sum with coefficient mass 0.8125
distillation_target_dependency.validator_behavior: The unchanged V4 trainer must run its mandatory all-data cache metadata, membership, hash and finite-value validation. No separate full cache rebuild is part of this recipe.

propensity_dependency.scope: own clean-fold-trained propensity model; its use on all supplied groups is explicitly recorded and provides no held-out claim

training_membership.sampler_note: The current trainer uses shuffled batches with drop_last=true: all 12,479 groups are eligible, while each B16 epoch samples 12,464 rows and omits 15 groups; the omitted identities vary with seeded order. Do not claim every group is used in each epoch.

scientific_recipe.architecture: plain GRU, two layers, hidden width 256, dropout 0, input width 211 (raw 112 plus event 99), two main prediction outputs and existing auxiliary outputs; no family-specific head
scientific_recipe.initialization: Fresh default initialization; no pretrained or teammate weights and no cross-seed warm start.
scientific_recipe.horizon: Four epochs; save full epoch training state; retain fixed zero-based epoch 3, not best-epoch selection.
scientific_recipe.main_loss: WMSE with chunk normalization, distillation source cache variant, alpha 0.5 and bootstrap horizon 8.
scientific_recipe.row_weights: Own propensity c20260929_prop_f0 raised to power 2 with epsilon 0.03; valid true-mask epsilon 0.03; since-event weight 32 with floor 0.25.
scientific_recipe.ema: Mean-teacher consistency coefficient 1.0, EMA decay 0.999; save/use EMA representation at the fixed epoch checkpoint.
scientific_recipe.optimizer: Muon for recurrent matrices and hidden output projection; AdamW for input/output projections and vectors; gatewise=none means each packed recurrent matrix is orthogonalized whole; Muon groups use LR multiplier 3, momentum 0.95 and the explicit native-BF16-if-supported-else-FP32 matrix policy.
scientific_recipe.schedule: OneCycle with 5 percent warmup and the trainer's fixed final divisor of 100; base LR 0.001, weight decay 0.01; model autocast FP16 is independent from Muon matrix-math dtype.
scientific_recipe.no_selection: No evaluation loader or local grade is produced by this all-data fit.

fresh_fit_preconditions: The exact actual-device B16/C1000 profile in the bound profile contract is successful and independently reviewed.
Root approves the fit recipe and current source/cache/data identities.
Provider/host identity, quota, worker RAM, GPU allocator and observed VRAM are separately measured and durably admitted for one GPU worker.
Mandatory trainer-side all-data cache validation passes; no silent fill, sorting, truncation or source membership substitution.
A new attempt identity is used if this attempt has any launch/failure receipt; no output directory exists at launch.
fit_attempt.runtime_projection: Unknown until an actual-device/profile and end-to-end input phase are measured; do not reuse synthetic one-step timing as a fit ETA.
fit_attempt.postfit_gate: Require successful terminal receipt, fixed epoch-3 checkpoint hash, source/provenance and exact all-supplied memberships, plus finite artifact checks. Root owns any independent grade; no score is claimed here.
